notes: Summary of customer pain: DocketWave ingests downstream court records, contracts, and discovery bundles. They need a RAG stack that can: 1) index ~35-75M documents (PDFs, OCRed images, ESI bundles), 2) serve sub-500ms median and <1s 95th percentile for single-document search + reranking, 3) keep per-query cost predictable (goal < $0.015/query at 1k qps monthly avg once warmed), and 4) satisfy long retention (7+ years) and immutable audit logs for legal hold. They prefer private deployments (VPC-peered or on-prem node) due to client confidentiality and state-level data residency. SE notes: need to design a hybrid store — dense embeddings in dedicated vector DB w/ sharding + tiered cold storage for raw evidence. Reranker to live in same VPC to avoid egress; candidate approach: small dense index + offline heavy rerank using quantized LLMs (4/8-bit) for cost. Customer quote: "We will not accept a black-box cloud flow — we need explicit KMS control, audit trails, and verifiable retention policies." POC asks: sample dataset (50k docs) and a performance run with 10k synthetic queries, plus security architecture diagram.
